entries.title: Return to Your First Love
entries.reflection: The Lord calls His people to remember, repent, and return. Spiritual activity cannot replace wholehearted devotion to Christ. Examine the place prayer, obedience, and love occupy in your life today.
entries.prayer: Lord Jesus, restore my first love and teach me to obey Your Word.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: The psalmist asks God to revive His people so they may rejoice in Him. Revival is more than excitement: it calls us to turn from spiritual neglect and seek God with renewed obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, awaken sincere love for You in my heart and restore joy in walking with You.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Peter calls believers to reflect God's holiness in their conduct. Choose truthfulness and purity even when compromise appears easier; holiness belongs in ordinary decisions.
topics.prayer: Holy Father, teach me to reject compromise and honour You in my choices.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: This psalm describes God as a present refuge in trouble, not a promise that hardship will never come. Bring your fears to Him and seek wise support while remaining steadfast.
topics.prayer: Lord, steady my heart in difficulty and help me trust Your presence.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Paul's call to pray without ceasing encourages a continuing dependence on God throughout daily responsibilities. Remember someone who needs comfort and pray for them specifically.
topics.prayer: Father, make me attentive to others and faithful in prayer today.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls his hearers to repent and turn to God. Repentance is not merely regret; it involves a sincere turning from sin and confidence in the mercy offered through Christ.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, expose what I must turn from and lead me in genuine repentance.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Hebrews teaches that approaching God requires faith in who He is. Faith is not a technique for demanding outcomes; it trusts God's character and continues in obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my trust when answers are delayed and guide my next faithful step.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Jesus promises power through the Holy Spirit for witness. Spiritual power should direct attention to Christ and produce courageous, truthful testimony rather than personal display.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, empower me to witness faithfully and keep my motives pure.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Christ's commission sends His followers to proclaim the gospel widely. Speak clearly about salvation while treating every listener with patience, dignity and genuine concern.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, open a gracious opportunity for me to share Your gospel.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus identifies love among disciples as a visible mark of belonging to Him. Unity does not require ignoring truth; it calls for humility, forgiveness and practical care.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love fellow believers sincerely and repair strained relationships.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James warns against hearing God's Word without putting it into practice. After reading Scripture, identify one concrete act of obedience rather than settling for knowledge alone.
topics.prayer: Lord, turn what I learn from Scripture into faithful action today.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: James encourages believers who lack wisdom to ask God. Seek guidance prayerfully, examine Scripture carefully and welcome sound counsel before making important decisions.
topics.prayer: Father, give me humility to seek wisdom and patience to act rightly.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus calls His followers to readiness because the timing of His coming is unknown. Watchfulness means persevering in faith and obedience, not predicting dates or stirring fear.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me faithful, watchful and compassionate as I await Your return.

entries.title: The Call to Holiness
entries.reflection: God calls His children to holy conduct in every area of life. Holiness grows as we submit our thoughts, speech, relationships, and decisions to the truth of Scripture.
entries.prayer: Father, cleanse my heart and strengthen me to live in holiness.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: The plea for revival in Psalm 85 points to renewed joy in God. Seek a heart responsive to His Word, not simply an emotional moment or public excitement.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my delight in You and teach me to respond to Your Word.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Peter grounds the call to holiness in God's own character. Refuse dishonest speech today even if speaking truth costs you approval.
topics.prayer: Holy God, strengthen me to speak truthfully and live with integrity.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: The psalm calls God a refuge amid real trouble. When anxiety rises, remember that seeking His help can go alongside asking trustworthy people for support.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me courage to face today's concerns with faith and wisdom.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Paul's brief command to pray continually describes a life turned toward God. Carry a specific need before Him instead of treating prayer as a hurried ritual.
topics.prayer: Father, help me persevere in prayer for someone who needs encouragement.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls for repentance and turning to God. Confess wrongdoing without excuses and seek to make right any harm you have caused.
topics.prayer: Merciful Lord, lead me to sincere repentance and honest restitution where needed.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Hebrews connects faith with seeking God, not controlling Him. Obey what Scripture teaches even while the outcome of your circumstances remains uncertain.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to seek You faithfully without demanding my own timetable.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Jesus links the Spirit's power with witness. Ask for purity of motive so that ministry points others toward Christ rather than drawing attention to yourself.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, give me courage to testify about Christ with humility.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The commission to preach the gospel calls believers beyond comfortable circles. Listen respectfully to others and speak of Christ without coercion.
topics.prayer: Lord, make my witness clear, gentle and faithful to the gospel.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus says love identifies His disciples. Show that love through patient listening and a practical act of kindness toward someone you find difficult.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to love others in actions as well as words.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James warns against hearing Scripture without obeying it. Choose one instruction from today's reading and put it into practice before the day ends.
topics.prayer: Lord, help me act upon the truth I have received from Your Word.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: James invites those lacking wisdom to ask God. Before an important decision, compare your options with Scripture and seek sound counsel.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment and a teachable spirit in my decisions.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus calls believers to be ready because the hour is unknown. Faithful preparation means daily obedience and watchfulness rather than date predictions.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me ready through steadfast faith and loving service.

entries.title: A Heart That Prays
entries.reflection: Jesus taught His disciples to pray and not lose heart. Bring your needs before God faithfully, but also listen, give thanks, and submit to His will.
entries.prayer: Lord, establish steadfast prayer in my daily life.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: The question in Psalm 85 invites God's people to seek renewed life in Him. Let renewed prayer lead to repentance, reconciliation and obedience.
topics.prayer: Lord, revive my love for You and restore what neglect has weakened.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: God's holiness is the reason Peter gives for holy living. Examine whether your private choices reflect the same devotion you profess publicly.
topics.prayer: Father, make my conduct consistent with the holiness You require.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Psalm 46 speaks of God's nearness in trouble. Offer Him your fears honestly and take the next responsible step instead of surrendering to panic.
topics.prayer: God of refuge, steady my heart and guide me through difficulty.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer without ceasing is a continuing posture of dependence. Pause during ordinary tasks to remember God and intercede for your community.
topics.prayer: Lord, keep my heart attentive to You throughout the day.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Acts 3 calls people to turn to God. Genuine repentance includes rejecting the wrongdoing you have recognized, not merely regretting its consequences.
topics.prayer: Jesus, give me grace to turn away from sin and walk in truth.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Hebrews teaches that faith seeks God diligently. Continue doing what is right even when you cannot yet see the result.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen patient obedience when the way ahead is unclear.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Acts 1:8 presents the Holy Spirit as the source of power for witness. Ask that your words and conduct reflect the Christ you proclaim.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, shape my witness with courage, truth and compassion.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Jesus sends His followers to proclaim good news. Begin by understanding the listener's questions before explaining the hope found in Christ.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me wisdom to speak of salvation with clarity and respect.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christ calls His disciples to be known by love. Make peace where possible, refusing gossip that damages fellowship.
topics.prayer: Father, guard my tongue and help me build unity through truth and kindness.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James says hearing alone is insufficient. Let Scripture correct a habit, not merely furnish a quotation for conversation.
topics.prayer: Lord, make me willing to change when Your Word corrects me.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God welcomes requests for wisdom. Pray carefully, then weigh your choices against biblical principles rather than acting on impulse.
topics.prayer: Father, grant sound judgment and patience before I act.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: The unknown hour of Christ's return calls for steady readiness. Serve faithfully today instead of being distracted by speculative predictions.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, teach me watchfulness expressed through faithful service.

entries.title: Salvation Is in Christ
entries.reflection: The apostles proclaimed that salvation is found in Jesus Christ. Our confidence is not in personal achievement but in the Saviour who calls us to repentance and faith.
entries.prayer: Lord Jesus, help me trust You and proclaim Your saving grace.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: The psalmist asks God to renew His people so they may rejoice in Him. Seek revival through repentance and restored fellowship with God, not by chasing extraordinary experiences.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my love for You and give me joy in faithful obedience.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Peter's command to be holy rests on God's holy character. Turn from any practice you know is wrong and ask for grace to honour Him privately and publicly.
topics.prayer: Holy Father, purify my motives and help me choose what pleases You.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Psalm 46 calls God a refuge and present help amid trouble. His nearness offers hope even when circumstances take time to change.
topics.prayer: Lord, strengthen me to trust Your care while I face today's responsibilities.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Paul's instruction to pray without ceasing invites ongoing dependence on God. Bring your concerns and the needs of others before Him throughout the day.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me faithful in prayer and mindful of those who suffer.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls his listeners to repent and turn to God. Salvation is grounded in Jesus Christ; a changed direction should accompany a sincere response to the gospel.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, lead me to genuine repentance and a life shaped by Your grace.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Hebrews teaches that those who come to God must believe He is and seek Him. Faith rests on His character, not on a guarantee that every request will be granted as expected.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to seek You earnestly and remain faithful in uncertainty.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Jesus promised the Holy Spirit's power so His disciples could be witnesses. Depend on the Spirit for courage and truthfulness rather than seeking attention for yourself.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, empower me to testify about Jesus with humility and love.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Christ's commission calls believers to announce the gospel. Speak clearly of His saving work, while respecting the dignity and freedom of those listening.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me an opportunity to share the good news with gentleness.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus says love among disciples identifies them as His followers. Let truthful speech, forgiveness and practical help strengthen fellowship today.
topics.prayer: Father, make my love for other believers visible in sincere actions.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James warns against hearing God's Word without obeying it. Let today's Scripture move you toward a concrete act of honesty, kindness or repentance.
topics.prayer: Lord, make me a doer of Your Word and not only a hearer.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: James encourages believers to ask God for wisdom. Seek His guidance and examine counsel carefully in the light of Scripture before acting.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment and the humility to receive correction.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus urges readiness because the hour of His return is unknown. Prepare through faithfulness and holy living, not predictions that Scripture does not authorize.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me watchful and obedient as I await Your coming.

entries.title: The Power of the Holy Spirit
entries.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers believers to witness for Christ. Seek His guidance so that courage, truth, love, and holy character accompany your testimony.
entries.prayer: Holy Spirit, guide my words and actions as I witness for Christ.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: The psalmist seeks renewal that brings joy in God. Ask the Spirit to revive repentance, Scripture reading and service, not merely enthusiasm at a meeting.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my devotion and make the fruit of revival visible in my conduct.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Peter calls believers to be holy because God is holy. The Spirit's power never excuses dishonesty or impurity; seek a clean heart alongside useful gifts.
topics.prayer: Holy Father, purify my choices and teach me to serve without compromise.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is a present refuge in trouble. Dependence on the Spirit does not mean denying hardship; it allows you to face difficulties with hope and steady judgment.
topics.prayer: Lord, strengthen me through trouble and guide me in wise decisions.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Paul calls believers to continuing prayer. Pray for those proclaiming the gospel, that they speak truthfully and show Christlike compassion.
topics.prayer: Father, sustain Your servants and teach me to intercede faithfully.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter's call to repentance directs people back to God. Spiritual experiences cannot substitute for turning from sin and trusting Jesus Christ.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, bring me to sincere repentance and lasting faith in You.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith seeks God with confidence in His character. Trust His Word when you cannot measure spiritual growth by dramatic feelings or immediate results.
topics.prayer: Father, deepen my faith and help me obey without seeking applause.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Jesus says the Holy Spirit will empower His followers to be witnesses. Seek courage to speak of Christ, with holiness and love governing how you use every gift.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, fill my witness with truth, courage and humility.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The commission to preach the gospel points beyond personal influence. Make the message of Jesus central, and listen respectfully when others ask questions.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me a clear opportunity to explain the gospel graciously.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Love identifies Jesus' disciples. Spiritual zeal should strengthen patient fellowship, not foster rivalry over gifts, positions or recognition.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to honour other believers and serve without pride.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James asks believers to act on what they hear. After praying for power, obey a clear instruction of Scripture in an ordinary responsibility today.
topics.prayer: Lord, help me practise Your Word in my actions and speech.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: James invites requests for wisdom. Test strong impressions carefully against Scripture and seek sound counsel instead of accepting every claim uncritically.
topics.prayer: Father, give me discernment and a humble willingness to be corrected.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Christ calls His followers to readiness without announcing a date. Live watchfully, using your time to serve rather than speculating about the hour.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep my witness faithful as I await Your return.

entries.title: Walk in the Light
entries.reflection: Walking in the light means living openly before God and responding to His truth. Refuse secret compromise, practise honesty, and seek forgiveness where you have fallen short.
entries.prayer: Father, keep my steps in Your light and truth.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival requires an honest return to God. Where secrecy has fostered wrongdoing, bring it into the light through confession, repentance and responsible change.
topics.prayer: Father, revive me through truth and bring neglected areas of my life under Your Word.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Peter links holiness to God's character. Walking in the light involves truthful conduct in private as well as a public profession of faith.
topics.prayer: Holy God, help me choose integrity when no one is watching.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: The Lord is refuge amid danger and uncertainty. Bringing concerns into the light does not require despair; trust Him and seek appropriate practical help.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my heart and help me face difficult truths with hope.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Continual prayer includes bringing hidden burdens honestly to God. Pray not only for relief but also for courage to make necessary changes.
topics.prayer: Lord, teach me honest prayer and the courage to act rightly.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls people to repent and turn to God. Do not conceal wrongdoing beneath religious language; confess and turn toward the mercy found in Christ.
topics.prayer: Merciful Jesus, lead me away from excuses into sincere repentance.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith approaches God believing His character is trustworthy. Remain truthful even when telling the truth seems more costly than hiding a mistake.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my faith to choose truth over convenience.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit empowers believers to witness to Jesus. His work should agree with the truth of Scripture, not provide a pretext for manipulation or pride.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, guide my words and guard me against misusing spiritual authority.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel is good news meant to be shared openly. Explain Christ's saving work with clarity rather than relying on fear or pressure.
topics.prayer: Lord, help me speak the gospel plainly and compassionately.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Love among disciples is visible and practical. Honest correction should be offered gently, and forgiveness should not be confused with permitting continued harm.
topics.prayer: Father, unite us in truth, patience and responsible love.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James says hearing must become doing. Let Scripture expose a behaviour you need to correct and follow through with a specific step.
topics.prayer: Lord, make my obedience sincere, especially in unseen choices.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God offers wisdom to those who ask. Examine claims in the light of Scripture and reliable evidence rather than being persuaded by confidence alone.
topics.prayer: Father, give me clear judgment and a love of truth.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus urges readiness for His unexpected return. Walk openly before God today rather than treating future watchfulness as a substitute for present obedience.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep my conscience tender and my conduct faithful.

entries.title: The Word in Your Heart
entries.reflection: Scripture shapes the heart when it is received, remembered, and obeyed. Make room for careful reading and meditation rather than treating the Bible as a hurried routine.
entries.prayer: Lord, plant Your Word deeply in my heart.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: God's people cry out for renewal in Psalm 85. Hide His Word in your heart by reading it carefully and letting it reshape daily desires.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my hunger for Scripture and my willingness to obey it.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: God calls His people to holiness. Memorising a verse helps when it guides choices; do not let familiarity with holy words replace holy conduct.
topics.prayer: Lord, make Your truth effective in my words, thoughts and actions.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Psalm 46 calls God our refuge. Recall His faithfulness from Scripture when fear clouds your judgment, while taking responsible steps to address the situation.
topics.prayer: Father, remind me of Your care and strengthen my courage today.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Paul's call to pray continually can be practised by praying through Scripture. Turn a short passage into a specific petition for your household.
topics.prayer: Lord, teach me to pray Your Word with understanding and love.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls for repentance and turning to God. Let Scripture confront cherished excuses and point you to the forgiveness offered in Christ.
topics.prayer: Jesus, correct my heart through Your Word and lead me in repentance.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith seeks God earnestly. Read a biblical promise within its context, trusting the Giver rather than assuming every promise describes your preferred outcome.
topics.prayer: Father, help me trust Your character and read Your Word faithfully.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers witness to Jesus. Depend on His help as you explain Scripture accurately rather than using isolated verses to impress others.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, guide me to speak the truth of Christ with humility.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Christ commands the gospel to be preached. Learn the message of His death and resurrection clearly so that those you speak to hear about Him, not only your experience.
topics.prayer: Lord, equip me to share the gospel accurately and kindly.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus says His disciples are known by love. Let Scripture change how you listen to, speak about and care for fellow believers.
topics.prayer: Father, make Your Word bear fruit in patient and practical love.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James commands believers to do the Word. Choose one instruction from today's reading and obey it before looking for another passage.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me grace to practise the truth I have learned.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: James invites believers to ask God for wisdom. Understanding Scripture requires humility; consider context and accept correction where your interpretation has been careless.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me careful understanding and wise application of Your Word.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus calls His people to be ready. Scripture nourishes watchfulness when it leads to steadfast obedience rather than obsessive searches for secret dates.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me grounded in Your truth and prepared through faithful living.

entries.title: Faith That Obeys
entries.reflection: Hearing the Word is a beginning, not the end. Let today's reading change a practical decision: speak truthfully, forgive someone, serve faithfully, or turn away from sin.
entries.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Psalm 85 joins revival to joy in God. A renewed heart responds to Scripture with obedience, even when duties interrupt personal plans.
topics.prayer: Lord, renew my love for You and make me patient in interrupted plans.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Peter calls believers to be holy as God is holy. Responding patiently when interrupted can be an act of holiness rather than merely good manners.
topics.prayer: Father, guard my speech when I am inconvenienced and form Your character in me.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Psalm 46 describes God as refuge in trouble. An unexpected setback need not govern your response; pause, seek wisdom and trust His care.
topics.prayer: God of refuge, grant me steadiness when the day goes differently than expected.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Continual prayer includes ordinary disruptions. Instead of resenting every interruption, ask whether someone needs your attention or intercession.
topics.prayer: Lord, teach me to carry others' needs faithfully in prayer.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Acts 3 calls people to repent and turn to God. Where irritation exposes selfishness, acknowledge it honestly rather than excusing unkindness.
topics.prayer: Jesus, lead me to repent when my impatience harms others.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Hebrews says faith seeks God. Trust His wisdom when obedience requires flexibility instead of control over every moment.
topics.prayer: Father, help me remain faithful when my schedule changes.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Jesus promised the Spirit's power for witness. Let gentleness under pressure support, rather than contradict, what you say about Christ.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, make my response to interruptions a truthful witness.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel commission involves people, not just plans. Be prepared to listen when an unexpected conversation becomes an opportunity to explain Christ.
topics.prayer: Lord, open my eyes to respectful opportunities to share Your gospel.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christ says disciples are known by love. When someone interrupts your work, give a kind answer without neglecting necessary boundaries.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me loving patience and wise boundaries.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James warns against hearing without doing. Practise today's reading by choosing a considerate response to a real inconvenience.
topics.prayer: Lord, turn the Scripture I hear into obedient action.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: James invites requests for wisdom. Distinguish urgent responsibilities from distractions rather than reacting to every demand with anger.
topics.prayer: Father, give me discernment to respond wisely and calmly.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus urges readiness for an unknown hour. Faithfulness includes the ordinary moments when plans change and character is tested.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me watchful and gracious in daily responsibilities.

entries.title: Love One Another
entries.reflection: Jesus taught His disciples to love one another. Christian love is expressed in patience, honesty, service, and care for people who may be overlooked.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me show Christlike love in my relationships.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival turns attention toward God and renews concern for people. Ask whether someone overlooked by others needs encouragement today.
topics.prayer: Father, revive compassion in me and help me notice the lonely.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Holiness follows God's character. Do not treat people as unimportant because they lack influence, recognition or resources.
topics.prayer: Holy God, remove pride from my conduct toward others.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God's presence offers refuge in trouble. Share hope without claiming that every difficulty will disappear immediately.
topics.prayer: Lord, help me offer truthful encouragement to someone in distress.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer without ceasing includes intercession for people whose burdens you do not fully know. Remember one such person by name today.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray thoughtfully for those who feel forgotten.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Repentance is a return to God. If you have ignored or mistreated someone, acknowledge it and make amends where appropriate.
topics.prayer: Jesus, forgive my indifference and lead me toward responsible kindness.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith seeks God and trusts His character. Let belief become practical help when someone faces uncertainty.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my trust and make me generous with my time.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers testimony to Jesus. Speak about Christ with compassion, especially to those who rarely feel heard.
topics.prayer: Spirit of God, give me attentive ears and gracious words.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel commission is for all people. Avoid favouritism when deciding whom to welcome into a conversation about Christ.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me courage to share Your gospel without prejudice.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus teaches that disciples are recognised by love. Include someone who might otherwise be left outside fellowship.
topics.prayer: Father, make Your love visible in the welcome I extend.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James calls readers to put the Word into practice. Move beyond a kind intention by offering specific, appropriate help.
topics.prayer: Lord, help me act on Your Word through practical service.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God gives wisdom to those who ask. Consider whether the support someone needs is companionship, encouragement or practical assistance.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to offer help that is wise and respectful.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Christ's call to readiness encourages faithful living now. Let your care for unnoticed people be part of your preparation.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me ready through steady love and service.

entries.title: Courage to Witness
entries.reflection: The gospel is the power of God unto salvation. Do not be ashamed of Christ; speak with humility, clarity, and compassion when an opportunity arises.
entries.prayer: Lord, grant me boldness and wisdom to share the gospel.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: A revived heart returns to God and seeks peace. Let forgiveness begin with surrendering resentment rather than pretending wrongdoing was acceptable.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my heart and deliver me from bitterness.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Holiness belongs to God and shapes our response to harm. Refuse retaliation while pursuing truthful and appropriate boundaries.
topics.prayer: Holy Lord, help me respond to wrong without becoming unjust.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is a refuge in distress. When hurt has unsettled you, seek His comfort and trustworthy support rather than isolating yourself.
topics.prayer: Lord, be my refuge and guide me toward healing and wise support.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Continual prayer can include difficult relationships. Pray for wisdom, protection and freedom from resentment without excusing mistreatment.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray honestly about strained relationships.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter's call to repentance applies to those who have wronged others. If you caused harm, admit it and seek to put matters right.
topics.prayer: Jesus, give me humility to confess wrongdoing and change my ways.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith seeks God rather than revenge. Entrust judgment to Him while taking reasonable steps to remain safe and truthful.
topics.prayer: Father, help me trust You and act with integrity.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit gives power for faithful witness. Courage includes refusing to use religious language to pressure someone into silence about harm.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, make me brave, truthful and compassionate.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel offers forgiveness through Christ. Explain grace without implying that reconciliation can be demanded from a harmed person.
topics.prayer: Lord, help me communicate Your grace with care and honesty.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus says love identifies His disciples. Forgiveness does not cancel accountability; love seeks truth and refuses cruelty.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me merciful love that honours justice.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James says the Word must be obeyed. Put away gossip and retaliatory speech, and pursue a responsible path to peace.
topics.prayer: Lord, guard my tongue and guide my conduct toward peace.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God invites requests for wisdom. Seek counsel before deciding how to address serious conflict or broken trust.
topics.prayer: Father, grant discernment about boundaries and reconciliation.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Readiness for Christ is expressed in faithful character. Reject grudges while remembering that wise protection and accountability remain important.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep my heart free of hatred and my actions upright.

entries.title: The Grace to Forgive
entries.reflection: Forgiveness reflects the kindness God has shown us in Christ. It does not mean ignoring wrongdoing, but it does call us to reject bitterness and seek peace wisely.
entries.prayer: Father, teach me to forgive and pursue what is right.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: The psalmist calls for God to revive His people. Renewal includes a willingness to reconcile where possible and reject cherished bitterness.
topics.prayer: Father, restore my joy in You and soften resentment in my heart.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: God's holiness calls for integrity. An apology without changed behaviour is incomplete; let repentance show through consistent conduct.
topics.prayer: Holy Father, give me integrity to put right what I can.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is refuge in trouble. Someone struggling with hurt may need patient companionship rather than a demand to feel better at once.
topics.prayer: Lord, make me patient and gentle toward wounded people.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Praying continually includes asking God for wisdom in relationships. Name the situation honestly without using prayer to avoid responsibility.
topics.prayer: Father, guide me toward responsible choices in difficult relationships.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls people to repent and turn to God. Where you caused harm, stop the behaviour and take appropriate steps toward restitution.
topics.prayer: Jesus, give me courage to confess my wrongs and make amends.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith seeks God even when reconciliation is slow. Trust Him while respecting another person's need for time and boundaries.
topics.prayer: Father, give me patience and respect as trust is rebuilt.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit empowers faithful witness. Let humility and truthful conduct demonstrate Christ more clearly than claims of spiritual importance.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, remove pride and guide my actions toward peace.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel announces Christ's saving grace. Share forgiveness as a gift offered by God, not a tool for forcing others into unsafe situations.
topics.prayer: Lord, help me speak of grace with wisdom and compassion.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus teaches love among disciples. Love listens seriously to reports of wrongdoing and never mistakes silence for unity.
topics.prayer: Father, make our fellowship truthful, caring and accountable.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James urges believers to do the Word. Practise forgiveness through a concrete refusal to spread retaliatory gossip.
topics.prayer: Lord, restrain my words and help me act with kindness.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God offers wisdom freely. Consider the counsel of mature, trustworthy people before attempting a difficult reconciliation.
topics.prayer: Father, help me recognise wise counsel and appropriate boundaries.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Watchfulness for Christ's return includes moral integrity now. Seek peace diligently without neglecting accountability or safety.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me faithful, just and compassionate.

entries.title: Be Ready for His Coming
entries.reflection: Christ's call to readiness should produce faithful living rather than speculation. Use today to follow Him, serve others, and keep your conscience clear before God.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me live faithfully with eternity in view.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival should turn hearts toward God, not endless speculation. Rejoice in Him through prayer, repentance and faithful service today.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my devotion and protect me from empty distractions.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: God calls His people to holiness. Readiness for Christ is reflected in conduct now, including honesty in ordinary responsibilities.
topics.prayer: Holy Lord, make my daily choices pleasing to You.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is refuge amid trouble. Hope in Christ's return need not dismiss present grief or make exaggerated promises about immediate relief.
topics.prayer: Lord, sustain those in difficulty and teach me compassionate hope.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Paul urges continual prayer. Intercede for your neighbours and community rather than spending your energy on alarming predictions.
topics.prayer: Father, help me pray faithfully and serve people near me.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls people to repent. An interest in end-time events cannot replace personal repentance and faith in Christ.
topics.prayer: Jesus, lead me into genuine repentance and steadfast trust.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Hebrews says faith seeks God. Continue obeying His Word without insisting that you know when future events will occur.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen patient faith that rests in Your character.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Jesus promised the Holy Spirit for witness. Use your gifts to point people toward Christ, not to promote unverifiable prophetic dates.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, give me truthful words and faithful motives.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel commission directs believers to proclaim salvation. Invite people to consider Christ without exploiting fear of the future.
topics.prayer: Lord, help me share the gospel clearly and respectfully.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Love among disciples should remain visible during disagreement about future events. Speak with humility and avoid needless division.
topics.prayer: Father, unite us in love while we remain faithful to Scripture.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James commands obedience to the Word. Apply today's reading by serving someone instead of only discussing future events.
topics.prayer: Lord, make me obedient in the opportunities before me.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God grants wisdom to those who ask. Examine end-time claims against Scripture and reject dates or guarantees the Bible does not provide.
topics.prayer: Father, give me discernment and protect me from speculation.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus commands readiness because the hour is unknown. Prepare through faith, holiness and service rather than prediction.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me watchful and faithful until You come.

entries.title: Strength in Trials
entries.reflection: Difficult seasons can test perseverance. Ask God for wisdom, remain rooted in His promises, and seek help from trusted believers when burdens feel heavy.
entries.prayer: Father, sustain my faith and grow patience in me.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: The prayer for revival seeks renewed joy in God. In a hard season, make room for honest lament as well as trust and perseverance.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my hope while I walk through difficulty.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Holiness is grounded in God's character. Trials do not excuse cruelty or dishonest shortcuts; ask for grace to continue doing right.
topics.prayer: Holy Lord, strengthen me to act uprightly under pressure.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Psalm 46 calls God a present refuge in trouble. Seeking practical and emotional support can accompany faith rather than contradict it.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me courage to ask for help and wisdom to receive it.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer without ceasing includes weary prayers. You need not disguise hardship from God; bring your concerns to Him truthfully.
topics.prayer: Father, hear me in this difficult season and strengthen my endurance.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls people to repent and return to God. Hardship should not be treated automatically as proof of personal sin.
topics.prayer: Jesus, keep me close to You and protect me from unfair judgments of others.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Hebrews says those who approach God must trust Him. Faith can persevere through unanswered questions without pretending pain is unreal.
topics.prayer: Father, help me trust You while I cannot see the way forward.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers witness. Even during trials, speak of Christ honestly without claiming believers never struggle.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, give me strength to witness with sincerity.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel is good news for people in every circumstance. Offer comfort and hope without treating suffering as an opportunity for pressure.
topics.prayer: Lord, teach me compassionate words when others are hurting.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Love among believers matters especially in hardship. Offer practical assistance and patient presence rather than quick judgments.
topics.prayer: Father, make me attentive to people facing heavy burdens.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James calls believers to live by the Word. When tested, choose one small act of obedience without demanding perfection from yourself.
topics.prayer: Lord, steady my steps and help me practise Your teaching today.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: James invites those lacking wisdom to ask God. Seek careful advice about decisions made under stress instead of acting in haste.
topics.prayer: Father, give me understanding and sound counsel during trials.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Readiness for Christ includes steadfastness through difficulty. Continue in hope without denying the need for rest, support and wise care.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, sustain my faith and keep me faithful through hardship.

entries.title: Revive Us Again
entries.reflection: True revival begins with renewed attention to God. Turn from spiritual indifference, treasure Scripture, and pray that your life may reflect Christ's character.
entries.prayer: Lord, revive my heart and use me for Your glory.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Psalm 85 asks God to revive His people again. Let prayer for renewal lead to confession, renewed love and concrete obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my heart and restore joy in serving You.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Peter's call to holiness reminds us that revival and character belong together. Renounce compromise instead of seeking excitement without change.
topics.prayer: Holy God, cleanse my motives and direct me toward righteousness.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: The Lord is refuge and strength in trouble. Encourage those in your congregation who feel discouraged by slow change.
topics.prayer: Lord, renew hope in weary hearts and give us patience.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer without ceasing makes revival a sustained pursuit rather than a single event. Intercede thoughtfully for your community today.
topics.prayer: Father, teach us faithful intercession beyond meetings and programmes.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls hearers to repent and turn to God. Genuine revival begins with the grace of Christ and a sincere turning from sin.
topics.prayer: Jesus, bring us to honest repentance and renewed faith.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Hebrews says faith seeks God. Do not measure revival only by crowd size or visible excitement; seek a life of trust and obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen our faith when results are not immediately visible.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Jesus promises the Holy Spirit's power for witness. Ask that spiritual gifts serve Christ's mission and be exercised with holiness and humility.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, empower us to witness with purity and love.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Christ commands the proclamation of the gospel. Let renewed zeal become compassionate, truthful outreach rather than competition for recognition.
topics.prayer: Lord, make us willing to share the gospel with humility.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus says disciples are known by love. A revived congregation should care for people, repair divisions and resist rivalry.
topics.prayer: Father, renew love and honest unity among Your people.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James commands hearers to become doers. Evaluate revival by what changes in conduct, mercy and everyday obedience.
topics.prayer: Lord, make the truth we hear visible in the way we live.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God welcomes requests for wisdom. Test teachings and practices against Scripture rather than accepting everything presented as revival.
topics.prayer: Father, give Your people discernment and a love of biblical truth.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus calls believers to readiness. Genuine revival strengthens ongoing watchfulness and faithful service, not forecasts about the date of His return.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep us holy, watchful and devoted to Your work.
